resources.string: Open today\'s day and the app leads the way: warm-up, set by set with its weight and reps, and the rest timer running on its own. No need to remember which set you were on.
On the home screen, the top block: “Today’s workout”.
Rest alerts with your phone in your pocket
It alerts you even with the screen off and the app closed. And from the lock screen you can move to the next set without unlocking your phone.
It pops up after every set. If it doesn\'t ring, the home screen tells you which permission is missing.
It tells you when to add weight

When you finish every set above the rep range, it suggests more load (using the jumps your machine really has) and tells you why underneath. Stuck for three sessions? It suggests dropping back to build up again.
During the workout, and the history in “My weights”, in the bottom bar.
Your numbers, not just a list
Weight lifted, estimated strength, streaks and a muscle map showing what each muscle got this week. That\'s what warns you you\'ve skipped legs for three weeks.
The plan is yours. So is the data
Fifteen plans are included, but you can bring your own or build one in the app. No account, no server: everything stays on your phone, so backups are up to you.
“My plans” on the home screen, and backup in Settings (the gear at the top).
None of this is saved: it\'s only used to suggest a plan.
There are fifteen plans inside. I can recommend one in five questions, or you can browse them yourself.
I just want to log my workouts
How much time do you have each day?
And if you have a spare day, you can add %1$s on top of any of these.
WHAT I DO HAVE FOR THIS
It\'s a short block: do it alone or on top of any plan, without changing your week.
Out of it for a while
It\'s worked out on your phone and thrown away. No accounts, no server.
Tap a section to open it. Reading the help changes nothing: if you have a workout going, it\'ll be exactly as you left it.
What\'s on today and how you\'re doing.

string-array.name: ayu_help_inicio_steps
string-array.item: Top right, ⓘ opens this help (it\'s also in Settings and in the workout header) and the gear opens settings.
Below, the plan you\'re following and its phase. “See other plans” takes you to the list: there are strength plans, muscle plans, home plans, plans for starting from scratch…
The big block is today\'s day. “Start day” begins the guided workout; “See the day before starting” shows the exercises without starting anything.
If you have a workout half done, that block says “In progress” and the button picks it up where you left off.
“Free workout” is for training without the plan, with rest timers and logging as you go. “Special workouts” are one-off routines that don\'t count as a day.
At the bottom, the bar: Badges, My weights, Results and Stats.

resources.string: A day\'s exercises, before or after you do it.

string-array.name: ayu_help_dia_steps
string-array.item: Each exercise with its drawing, sets and reps (“3 x 12”) and the rest between sets.
“How to do it” opens the guide: muscles, technique, common mistakes, alternatives and a video.
“Log by hand” is for a day you trained without the app. Guided workouts are logged automatically when you finish.
If that day\'s workout is half done, the button says “Continue workout”.

resources.string: How long the day takes and how to trim it if you\'re short on time.

string-array.name: ayu_help_expres_steps
string-array.item: When you start you see how long the day usually takes. The estimate learns from how long you actually take.
Short on time? Pick 45 or 30 minutes: every exercise drops to 2 sets and, if it still doesn\'t fit, the last ones are cut. The app tells you which.
An express workout counts as a day done, just like a full one.

resources.string: What you do with the machine in front of you.

string-array.name: ayu_help_serie_steps
string-array.item: Set the weight with − and + (half a kilo at a time; hold to go faster), with “Wheel” or by tapping the number to type it.
Reps come filled in from the plan: only touch them if today you did a different number.
“Warm-up set” logs a ramp-up set without using up a plan set.

“Skip” is for when that exercise doesn\'t fit right now: “Machine taken” moves it to the end, “Do another one instead” swaps it for an alternative and “Not doing it today” crosses it out (what you did stays logged; the rest doesn\'t count).
“Plan” shows the whole day and where you are, with skipped ones crossed out at the end.
When you\'re done, “Set done”.

string-array.name: ayu_help_descanso_steps
string-array.item: Rest depends on the exercise: your usual one for normal sets (1:30 unless you change it in Settings), 3 minutes for heavy sets (8 reps or fewer on a compound lift) or whatever the plan says. Under the number it says where it comes from.
−30 s and +30 s adjust it. If you change it between sets, next time that exercise starts with your rest.
It rings and vibrates when it ends, even with the screen off (and on your watch, if you use one).
“How did it go?” logs whether the set was easy, hard or to failure, and adds rest: “Tough” adds 30 s and “Failure” a minute. In “Next” you can set up the weight for the next set.

resources.string: If you don\'t have the machine
Do another exercise and have it logged as what it was.

string-array.name: ayu_help_maquina_steps
string-array.item: During the set, tap “Skip” → “Do another one instead” (or “How to do it” and scroll down to “If it\'s taken or you don\'t have it”).
The alternatives the app knows show up with their drawing: tap “Do this” and today\'s exercise becomes that one, with its own weights.
“I did a different exercise…” searches 151 exercises or lets you type your own.
With “Remember it for next time” ticked, the following days start with the swap. “Back to the plan\'s one” undoes it.

resources.string: No plan, but with rest timers and everything logged as you go.

string-array.name: ayu_help_libre_steps
string-array.item: It starts with the warm-up: “I\'ve warmed up” skips it.
Do your set and tap “Set finished”. Rest starts right away and, while it runs, you pick which exercise it was (only the first time) and log weight and reps.
The next sets of the same exercise come with the previous values: only change what\'s different. “How did it go?” adds rest just like in the guided workout.
If you use your bodyweight, tick “Bodyweight, no weight”: it\'ll only ask for reps, and it remembers for next time.

If you type one the app doesn\'t know, like “TRX row”, it\'s saved on your phone as yours, with no drawing or muscle map. It\'s only offered with a plan you created: in search, in suggestions and when building the plan.
“Finish exercise” starts the rest between exercises; the next set asks again which one it is.
“Finish” shows everything you logged so you can review it before saving.

resources.string: Your workout saves itself as you go.

string-array.name: ayu_help_salir_steps
string-array.item: Your phone\'s back button takes you Home with the workout still running: resume it from the “In progress” block.
The X at the top asks what you want: “Finish and save” marks the day done with what you have, “Resume later” leaves it as is and “Discard workout” deletes it.
Looking at this help, the exercise guide or the plan never touches the workout.

string-array.name: ayu_help_resultados_steps
string-array.item: Every workout with its duration and, per exercise, the weight of each set.
“Newest / Oldest” changes the order.
If you did another exercise instead of the plan\'s, it shows with its name and “instead of…”.

resources.string: Your streak, your numbers and your progress.

string-array.name: ayu_help_estadisticas_steps
string-array.item: Summary: streak, days done, total time, sets and weight lifted.
Weights: how each exercise has gone up. Muscles: what you\'ve worked lately. Consistency: which days you train.

resources.string: The weight you work with on each exercise.

string-array.name: ayu_help_pesos_steps
string-array.item: Grouped by muscle. They fill in by themselves as you train and you can correct them.
It\'s the weight from your last session; your record (PR) shows under each exercise.

resources.string: Switch plans, import one or create your own.

string-array.name: ayu_help_planes_steps
string-array.item: Each plan keeps its own progress: switching plans deletes nothing.
Under each one: its goal (strength, muscle…), the days and how many you\'ve done.
“Create a plan” opens the editor; “Import” brings one in from JSON or Markdown.

resources.string: Your details, rest, reminders, theme and backup.

string-array.name: ayu_help_ajustes_steps
string-array.item: Weight (to estimate calories), the drawings\' gender and whether you use a watch.
Rest: default length between sets and between exercises.
Reminders: pick days and a time and the app tells you it\'s time to train.
Light or dark theme, and backup to take your progress to another phone.

resources.string: If you have a Wear OS watch.

string-array.name: ayu_help_reloj_steps
string-array.item: Install the watch app and the watch becomes a remote: “Set done”, skip rest or switch machines without taking out your phone.
The watch vibrates at the end of each rest and, while you train, shows the time left on the watch face.
